text_block_list.text:
One day, a dinner party was held under the 
banner of an "Umamusume and Media 
Discussion Meeting."

text_block_list.name: Magazine Journalist
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, comments filled with emotion are 
easy to turn into headlines. It's your 
chance to stand out, so keep that in 
mind!”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! That was very informative. Don't 
you think, Tact?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thank you very much for your valuable 
insight.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I learned so much in just this short 
time. Having another session like this 
tomorrow is amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. Since we have such a 
wonderful opportunity...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tact! Once we've had our fun at 
tomorrow's discussion meeting... do you 
think we could slip out a bit early?

The next day, Daring Heart slipped away 
from the party and came to the forest with 
Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks, Trainer. For agreeing to come 
with me."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I expected it to take until tonight, so 
that was a huge help!"
choice_data_list: It's okay, you can always rely on me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well then, you go have fun too! ...Listen, 
can't you hear it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The sound of flapping wings... That's a 
shrike, isn't it. I wonder if it spotted 
prey.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
From that way, big footsteps and little 
footsteps— A mother deer and her fawn. 
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, with the forest being this quiet, I 
can feel every shift in weight with 
absolute clarity.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're really coming alive, Tact! 
But the real thing starts now♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You know, I found this spot while I was 
secluded in the mountains training.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's a nice place.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You think it's just an ordinary river, 
don't you? Heheh, look up!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Isn't this a nostalgic sight for you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Just like back home. A sky with 
only the moon and stars floating in it...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Say, Tact. Back in your hometown, what 
kind of thoughts ran through your mind 
when you looked up at a night sky like 
this?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I was having a dream. A dream where I 
enrolled in Tracen Academy and ran in 
races.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Then it's the same. Just like the dream I 
had back in America.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well, your dream came true like this, but— 
was reality a little different from what 
you expected?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The differences from my hometown became so 
stressful that I've even dashed into fast 
food joints before.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I just wanted to get a taste of how 
things felt back in my hometown, even if 
just a little.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When things get tough, I secretly take a 
break too, you know. Though that's a 
secret from everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...So you realized. That I was tired from 
dealing with crowds—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what are you talking about? I just 
felt like coming here for the first time 
in a while, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you enjoyed it, please come 
again. At your own pace!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Heart-san... yes!
choice_data_list:
Maybe I should drop by here once in a 
while too...
Maybe I should come here more often too...

If you need someone to accompany you 
again, leave it to me!

Let's rest a little longer before we head 
down.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Heart-san... yes!
choice_data_list:
Maybe I should drop by here once in a 
while too...
Maybe I should come here more often too...

If you need someone to accompany you 
again, leave it to me!

Let's rest a little longer before we head 
down.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you tired too, Trainer? In that 
case, sitting by the campfire is the best 
medicine!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Phew... Okay. How was that, not 
bad right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Parties are nice, but spending time 
like this is wonderful too."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Um... if I ever want to come back here, 
would it be alright if I invited 
Heart-san?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind, but... Don't you want to 
relax by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I want to be alone. I 
just... want a moment of peace.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Fufu. Feel free to invite me 
anytime♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it lit up! The branches were damp, so 
I thought it wouldn't work.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nice! In that case, let's roast 
marshmallows!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Heart-san, being so 
prepared. Ufufu, thank you for the treat.

And so, the three of them gathered around 
the fire and enjoyed a relaxing time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That's strange... It won't light up.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The branches around here are damp. If only 
we had some paper, it would be easier to 
ignite...

In the end, we gave up on the bonfire and 
quietly headed down the mountain.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Really? In that case, maybe you'll join 
me for the breathtaking view just up 
ahead!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To think there's such an open space 
here...! It must feel wonderful to run 
here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Right? —How about it? Up for a run right 
now?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I feel like running with all my 
might!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Now that's the spirit! Come on, Tact!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, save it for another time. It'll take 
a toll on tomorrow, you know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Going downhill puts a greater 
strain on the legs, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "I'll be back, Tact. I promise!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good idea! If we're lucky, we might even 
see shooting stars!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Wah! I'd love to see it again after so 
long!

"And so, the three of us spent every last 
minute searching for shooting stars!"
